newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates HK Homes Funding's US$144 mln notes AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates HK Homes Funding's US$144 mln notes AAA.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned its AAA long-term credit rating to Hong Kong Homes Funding Corp Ltd's US$144 million mortgage-backed floating rate notes (FRNs) due 2017.

The notes are secured by a pool of Hong Kong dollar floating rate, fully amortising, owner occupied, residential mortgage loans originated by Sanwa Finance Hong Kong Ltd, a subsidiary of Sanwa Bank Ltd.

The rating primarily reflects the guarantee provided by MBIA Insurance Corp, which supports the full and timely payment of interest due on the monthly payment dates and ultimate repayment of principal no later than the notes' final maturity date in August 2017, S&P said.

The rating also reflects the 6.18 percent reserve fund, the interest rate and currency swap provided by Chase Manhattan Bank London branch, the very strong credit quality and historical performace of the mortgage loans, and the payment and legal structure of the transaction, it said.
The aggregate mortgage pool has a weighted average original loan-to-value ratio of about 63 percent and seasoning of about 1.5 years.
The mortgaged properties are spread throughout Hong Kong island, the Kowloon peninsula and the New Territories, S&P said.
